t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Green, blue, orange, and yellow (gnomes?) take you to one area and the other colours take you to another. You should choose one group or the other consistently until the mushroom yield starts to decrease. Once it starts to decrease you should switch to consistently choosing the other group.

vb_textbox.text: Green, yellow, orange and blue gnomes take you to one forest. The other colour gnomes take you to another forest. Choose one forest consistently until you see the number of mushrooms decrease (to 1, 2, or maybe 3), then switch to the other forest (as the number of mushrooms in the other forest will start to increase).
